fields.description: Show the Add-ons area (LLM / storage services) in the console. Off hides its nav entry and blocks its routes.
fields.label: Enable Add-ons

fields.description: Minutes a trial server may sit idle before its region puts it to sleep. Customer traffic wakes it. Set 0 to keep trial servers awake. A paid server never sleeps, and a resize ends sleep for good.
fields.label: Trial Idle Shutdown (Minutes)

fields.description: Base domain of every regional service. Central reaches proxy.<region>.<wildcard domain>, atlas.<region>.<wildcard domain>, and cargo.<region>.<wildcard domain>. Example: frappe.dev
fields.label: Wildcard Domain

fields.description: This Central's id in Atlas's Configure Webhooks call. Atlas refuses anything but 1 unless its developer mode is on or it allows multiple Central webhooks -- raise this only where more than one Central environment shares an Atlas.
fields.label: Central ID

fields.description: The Pilot release tag servers may update to, e.g. v0.0.50-pre-alpha. Empty means Pilot offers the newest GitHub release, as before.
fields.label: Pilot Release Tag

fields.description: Kill switch. Stops offering the tag to anyone who has not updated yet. Servers already on it stay on it.
fields.label: Pilot Rollout Halted

fields.description: Percent of servers offered the tag. Servers set to early always get it, late only at 100. Set 100 to release to everyone.
fields.label: Pilot Rollout Percent

fields.description: Once this percent of the first group runs the tag, Central sets the rollout to 100 for everyone. 0 turns this off, so only an admin releases to everyone.
fields.label: Auto Release At Percent
